steps: Ask for a free flight estimation (form, chat, call, text, WhatsApp, or email).
We check the price fast, ideally while still talking — flight prices can change in minutes.
Agree the price, then reserve — every traveler's name must match their passport exactly.
Pay Flight the exact agreed amount, then confirmation and receipt by email.
